title: Send your Claude Whiteboard to Lucid and keep building
summary: Claude Whiteboards can now go straight to Lucid. Turn a quick sketch into diagrams, plans, and processes your whole team can build on.
body_markdown:
More and more work starts in a conversation with AI. But as you talk through a plan with Claude, it won’t be long before you want to see it: the process steps, the systems, how the pieces connect.


Today,[Anthropic launched Claude Whiteboard , opens in a new tab](https://claude.com/resources/articles/sheets-whiteboards-data) , an artifact for brainstorming ideas right inside Claude. Anthropic worked with Lucid on the launch, so when you are ready to collaborate with your team to create more defined, data-backed, and governable documentation, you can send it straight to Lucid. Your board will open in Lucid as an editable document, ready for you and your team to work on. There's nothing to copy, paste, or redraw.


## Why Claude and Lucid work better together


By sending your Claude Whiteboard to Lucid, you’ll keep ideas and documentation within the centralized space where your team already plans and makes decisions. Plus, you’ll gain access to advanced capabilities within Lucid. From our platform, you can:


-


**Collaborate in real time:** Invite teammates to add ideas, leave comments, and refine the board together.


-


**Align on a decision:** Use Visual Activities and voting to determine next steps.


-


**Refine diagrams:** Use Lucid AI to edit visuals automatically or intuitive tools on the newly renovated Lucidchart canvas to make small updates manually.


-


**Add data:** Link data for more dynamic diagrams.


-


**Share your work safely:** Use the sharing and permission controls your Lucid admins already manage.


This connection is made possible with the[Lucid MCP server , opens in a new tab](https://lucid.co/platform/mcp-server) , the same connection that lets you search, summarize, edit, and create Lucid documents from Claude.


New to the Lucid MCP server?


[Read the launch post](https://lucid.co/blog/lucid-mcp-server)


## Ways to use Claude Whiteboard with Lucid


Not sure where to apply this technology in your workflow? Here are some ideas:


-


**Plan and prioritize work:** Brainstorm options with Claude, then send the board to Lucid for your team to prioritize and assign owners.


-


**Map out system architecture:** Capture requirements and elements of your system in Claude Whiteboard. Then turn that information into a detailed system architecture diagram in Lucidchart that technical and non-technical stakeholders can review.


-


**Create process documentation:** Capture your thoughts about a workflow with Claude. Then keep it in Lucid as a process your team can follow and update.


## How to get started


The ability to send a Claude Whiteboard to Lucid is available to Lucid Free, Individual, Team, and Enterprise plans. It is not currently available for FedRAMP accounts. On Team and Enterprise accounts, a Lucid admin must enable MCP access first. Claude Whiteboard availability depends on your Claude plan.


Follow these steps to send your work from Claude Whiteboard to Lucid:


1.


Connect Lucid to Claude. Add the Lucid connector from the[Claude directory , opens in a new tab](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/0cce5c8c-7590-41d0-abbe-aa5c64961ac0) . For more detailed instructions on this process,[visit our help center , opens in a new tab](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/0cce5c8c-7590-41d0-abbe-aa5c64961ac0) .


2.


In Claude Whiteboard, click **Share** and then **Export** .


3.


Under **Send to** , select **Lucid** . Your board will then open in Lucid.


Your best ideas don't have to stay in a chat window. Get your thoughts down in Claude, send them to Lucid, and build with your team. We can't wait to see what you make.
